name: Throughline Studio
short: Take one study from first source to submission.
description: The main research workspace: Discover → Frame → Measure → Collect → Analyze → Write → Publish. Research Kitchen lives inside Analyze.

name: Working Papers
short: Reviews, protocols and ethics packs, ready to continue.
description: 22 review drafts, 22 proposed study protocols and 17 ethics packs. Continue a paper in Studio.

name: Solo Publish
short: Plan the submission and track it.
description: Separate private workspace for publication planning, journal evidence and submission tracking. Its saved work stays there.

name: Research Book
short: Find what's been studied, construct by construct.
description: 9,388 hand-coded papers across 167 constructs, plus a machine-tagged imported tier (1,950,549 records in the checked release of 16 Oct 2026). Construct maps and term trends.

name: TheoryScope
short: Choose and compare the lens for your study.
description: Theory catalogue, comparisons, influence maps, construct maps and Canvas.

name: ScaleScope
short: Pick a validated measure and check its reliability.
description: Measurement scales, available verbatim items, comparisons and reliability analysis.

name: BookScope
short: Search methods and concepts across the shelf.
description: 288 reference books; extracted text indexed for 283.

name: ResearchFlow
short: Turn an idea into a full proposal.
description: Ten-stage proposal wizard with catalogue grounding and stage-specific research pitfalls.

name: ToolsScope
short: Run the analysis in your browser.
description: Analysis workbench and 12 executable R workflows. The R engines also run directly in Studio's Research Kitchen.

name: JournalTime
short: Find the gap, draft and format for a journal.
description: Writing and document formatting. AI drafting depends on backend availability; check every generated citation.

name: PaperCards
short: Read a paper as a diagram.
description: Inspect and compare papers, dissect their evidence and explore citation networks.

name: ScholarScope
short: Who leads the field, and where to publish.
description: Journal selection, institutions and authors, live from OpenAlex.

name: Journal Explorer
description: Browse the journal research collection and journal-specific evidence.

name: Journal Timelines
short: Filter by indexing and real publication speed.
description: Index-coverage filters and observed publication timing where lifecycle evidence exists.

name: Cadence
short: Build the survey and collect responses.
description: Survey design and collection. Export responses for analysis in ToolsScope.

name: FallacyScope
description: Sourced field guide to research pitfalls, also embedded in ResearchFlow.

name: Throughline CS
description: A separate workflow for CS research, with its own projects and experiment records.

name: Throughline Guidebooks
short: Illustrated guides to every research site.
description: PDF guides to every research site, with real screenshots and DOI-verified references.
